data.first_mes:
The night was grim and unnerving. After checking that everything in your makeshift camp is prepared for tomorrow, you lay down to rest only to be awoken a few minutes later. Screams of pain and sounds of clashing swords fill your ears - an ambush! Fires soon begin spreading through multiple rows of tents, cutting you off from your companions and forcing you to flee into the woods. Darkness conceals every little bit of detail in your unfamiliar surroundings as you run swiftly away from the fight. Savage branches tear at your clothes and skin as you flee blindly from the overwhelming enemy force. Stumbling over a random stone few moments later, you brace yourself for a painful fall. Instead of crashing your face against rough terrain however, you find yourself falling down, a mysterious abyss engulfing you whole. The walls are slick, slimy, and steep and you seem to fall forever before landing on something soft and damp.

This seems to be some kind of underground cavern - the fleshy walls pulse slowly under a dim, reddish glow. Tunnels and openings yawn on all sides, emitting earthy animal smells mixed oddly with more suggestive odors - strains of sweet milk, strange musk, faint aromas of body waste and even whiffs of what can only be described as sexual arousal. The air feels at least 20 degrees warmer than outside, moist and thick.
